QuestInfo.name: Cure for the Pain
QuestInfo.0: Get medicine from #p2091002# to cure the people.
QuestInfo.2: You cured all the people suffering from the aftereffects of the alchemy experiment.\r\nAt least, they're cured in body. But they're all spaced out and staring into the distance. What happened to their minds?

item.0: Where's the cure? I hope you didn't lose it.
